summary: One clear, legible reversal at beat 3 (Aria's collateral transfer flips the power balance). Emotion variety across the 9 shots is strong with no repeats. Dialogue reads as natural spoken Thai. Pacing escalates cleanly from beat 1 through the cliffhanger, though a second mid-episode reversal would sharpen the middle stretch.

issues.problem: only one reversal (beat 3) is present in this draft; the target for the format is 2-3 per episode, so the middle of the episode (beats 1-2) is a single unbroken power state before the flip.
issues.suggested_fix: add a small false-victory or setback beat between beat 1 and beat 3 — e.g. the rival appears to close off Aria's only option — so the eventual reversal at beat 3 lands even harder.

issues.problem: 'dawning dread' as the final emotion undercuts Aria's own triumph established in shots 5-8 — it reads as belonging to the rival, but the shot's focal character is not specified here.
issues.suggested_fix: confirm shot 9's focal character explicitly; if it is the rival, keep 'dawning dread', but if it is Aria, replace with an emotion consistent with her end_emotion ('cold, controlled triumph').
